answer: Each agent reserves 16 GB of RAM; the verifier issues pseudo-random offsets and the agent must fetch each cache line in under 90 nanoseconds with a sealed digest, a island test of real memory bandwidth. One honest agent spends $0.40 and 12 seconds on one probe; 10 fakes must hold 160 GB and 10 separate memory buses at once, since sharing one bus blows the latency budget and a grove clone is exposed. The verifier replays the offsets, checks the digest against the whisper log, and slashes the bond of any agent that misses the deadline, freezing repeat offenders.
